legend: LAB = production code on modelled engine types, compiled by MSVC in CI. SOURCE = text rule with a proven negative. BINARY = audit of the delivered DLL or the pinned host EXE. HUMAN = only the user can confirm it on Windows/DX12.

A_wounds.LAB: 45/80/certain preparation, legal transition only, rear wounds (lab_wound_guard); first wound then guard through the real hooks (w_fix04_mash)

B_guard.LAB: 12 angles with shield and body in one pass (w_fix03_shield); three held arm poses (w_fix04_mash); rising and lowered shield give real damage; three capsules = one verdict; a swing the aim test misses still finds the sphere
B_guard.HUMAN: real ANM_GUARD pose: BCK not read; LIZ_TRACE logs the real sphere offset

C_hp_posture.LAB: covered: HP intact, +5 once per distinct swing; uncovered: HP lost, +6

D_two_blocks.LAB: two blocks detected, one 80% roll, both outcomes forced by seed, frequencies in lab_deflect, new window, contact in and out of window

E_after_parry.LAB: +25 Link, +0 itself, native rebound, N/D 50/50 with real At, back to the four combos (w_counter, w_fix04_mash)
E_after_parry.HUMAN: the counter as seen and defended

F_parry_fx.LAB: every hook failure named and isolated by function; every callback counted; only confirmed parries orange and high; Link->Lizalfos, Link->Bokoblin (first contact included), Lizalfos->Link; revert, duplicates, scene change, deleted owner
F_parry_fx.BINARY: hook prologue audit on the pinned EXE
F_parry_fx.HUMAN: colour seen, pitch heard. Telemetry proves the route ran, not how it looks or sounds

I_lockon.LAB: lft03 and w_fix03_lockon unchanged; lockon_core.hpp and lockon_adapter.inc byte-identical to 0.12.3

J_stress.LAB: 16 slots, generations, delete, reuse, reentry; ASan clean locally on liz_world_lab

invariants.patterns: P1 N-D-C, P2 N-N-N-D-N-C, P3 D-N-D-N-N-D, P4 C-C-N-D-C
invariants.p3_impact_1: no specific work, by order of the user

limits: the labs run the production adapters on stub engine types; they prove logic and call order, not the game
the block arc is a design decision on the body's facing; the real shield pose was not read
a shield contact while the shield is still rising is not a block, by design
the HITNG texture was not read: if the blue lives in its pixels the orange will be partial; the log reports it
by-name hook targets are outside the prologue audit; the 0.12.3 log shows no failure for them
